name: Traditional Medicinals Throat Coat Tea (Slippery Elm & Licorice)
whyItWorks: Contains wild-harvested slippery elm inner bark, organic marshmallow root, and sweet licorice root. The high concentration of natural mucilage polysaccharides creates a soothing, protective gel coating across inflamed mucosal tissue.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pour 8 oz boiling water over tea bag and cover with a lid. Steep for a full 10-15 minutes, then gently squeeze the bag to express the viscous, mucosal-protective herbal extract.
